The structure of Rb2NaTlF6 crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a unit cell containing 40 atoms (Rb8 Na4 Tl4 F24) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Na and Tl each as octahedral centers coordinated by six F atoms, while Rb shows a close-packed-like 12-neighbor F environment. The Na- and Tl-centered octahedra share corners, and face-sharing occurs between Rb polyhedra and both Na- and Tl-centered octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
